sources.title: Amazon RDS regional endpoints

sources.title: App Service Environment v3 region and data boundary
sources.scope: Central India supported; app content/settings/secrets retained within deployment region. Separate services/identity not covered.

sources.title: Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server overview
sources.scope: Central India Intel compute and in-region HA support. Exact SKU availability/quota and deployment configuration still need review.

sources.title: Azure PostgreSQL backup and restore
sources.scope: Use in-region local/zone backup storage; disable geo-redundancy and cross-region read replicas for this profile.

sources.title: Lightsail Linux IPv4 instance bundles
sources.scope: 4 GiB/2 vCPU/80 GB SSD Linux IPv4 bundle at USD 24/month; burstable CPU and quotas need workload review.

sources.title: Lightsail regional endpoints
sources.scope: Mumbai, N. Virginia and Ireland service availability; primary VM placement only.

sources.title: Lightsail transfer, disk and snapshots
sources.scope: Included transfer is halved in Mumbai; inbound and outbound count toward allowances. Snapshot USD 0.05/GB-month and block disk USD 0.10/GB-month. No taxes, support or production capacity claim.

entries.name: Azure App Service Environment v3 (Central India, Linux Iv2)
entries.review_scope: Central India Linux containers on Isolated v2; choose internal networking, scoped logs/backups and no cross-region replication. Separate Entra/third-party data flows remain independently reviewed.
strengths: Managed application/container runtime; database is a separately provisioned managed service.
tradeoffs: Isolated v2 is materially more expensive than shared App Service; no dedicated physical host deployment is assumed.
No Entra geography, SQL Server migration/reuse, application SLA or legal certification follows from the regional compute profile.

entries.name: Amazon Lightsail Linux VM
entries.review_scope: Self-managed Linux VM with local PostgreSQL/MySQL, explicit region and burst-capacity review; not a managed database or HA service.
strengths: Published fixed monthly Linux IPv4 bundles include RAM, SSD and transfer allowance.
tradeoffs: Own patching, database recovery, TLS and burst CPU monitoring; no availability or capacity guarantee.
